traits.trust: Gives the benefit of the doubt

scenarios.prompt: The group chat decides at 1am that everyone's doing something tomorrow.

options.text: I'm in. I'll deal with being tired later.
Seen it. I'll reply in the morning.
In, but someone send the actual plan first.
Somehow I end up organising the whole thing.

scenarios.prompt: You said yes to something two weeks ago. It's tonight. You don't want to go.

options.text: Go anyway. I said I would.
Cancel. I'll survive the guilt.
Spend forty minutes writing the cancel text.
Show up for half an hour, then quietly leave.

scenarios.prompt: Someone in the group is clearly off tonight and hasn't said why.

options.text: Ask them straight out what's going on.
Say nothing now, text them privately after.
Leave it. They'll bring it up if they want to.
Start wondering if it's something I did.

scenarios.prompt: You open one link at 11pm out of mild curiosity.

options.text: Still reading at 1am, twelve tabs deep.
Skim it, close it, forget it existed.
Save it to read properly later. I won't.

scenarios.prompt: New place, and there's something on the menu you can't pronounce.

options.text: Order it. Worst case it's a story.
Get the thing I always get.
Ask what's actually in it, then decide.

scenarios.prompt: Group task, real deadline, and nobody has assigned anything yet.

options.text: Fine, I'll start handing out jobs.
Wait to be told what my bit is.
Quietly do my part properly and say nothing.

scenarios.prompt: Your room, right now, no tidying first.

options.text: Clean. I'd let anyone walk in.
The floor is doing storage.
Surfaces clear, drawers cursed.

scenarios.prompt: Ten minutes before you're meant to leave, they cancel.

options.text: Quiet relief, honestly.
Annoyed. I'd built my whole day around it.
Fine. I'll find something else to do with it.

scenarios.prompt: Someone you just met tells you a story that's slightly too good.

options.text: Believe it. Why would they make that up.
Nod along and quietly doubt all of it.
Start asking questions about the details.
Lying there running every possible version of it.
Out cold in about four minutes.
One more scroll. Then definitely sleep.

scenarios.prompt: Something breaks halfway through, and people are looking at you.

options.text: Go quiet and just fix it.
Brain empties. Someone else take this one.
Start talking it through out loud until it's solved.

scenarios.prompt: A task you've been avoiding for three days is still there.

options.text: Do it badly and get it gone.
Still avoiding it. Tomorrow.
Reorganise my entire to-do system instead.

openQuestions.anxiety: What's the thing your brain keeps going back to lately, even when there's nothing to do about it?
openQuestions.vulnerability_under_pressure: When did something last go sideways with people watching? What did you actually do?
openQuestions.assertiveness: When did you last want to say something in a room and didn't? What stopped you?
openQuestions.social_energy: Think of the last time you were properly around people. How did you feel walking home?
openQuestions.intellectual_curiosity: What have you gone way too deep on recently that nobody asked you about?
openQuestions.adventurousness: What's the last thing you did that you hadn't done before? How did that happen?
openQuestions.compassion: When did you last go out of your way for someone? Be specific about what it cost you.
openQuestions.trust: When did you last decide someone wasn't being straight with you? What tipped it?
openQuestions.orderliness: What's the one thing you keep genuinely organised, and what have you let fall apart?
openQuestions.self_discipline: What did you start this year and stop? What actually happened there?
